| # Safety feature configuration check {#safety-feature-configuration-check-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                           |                                                                                                                                                     |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Microcontroller provides various safety features in hardware, like ECC, lockstep−cores, E2E protection of internal communication, internal watchdogs, internal error management and so on. Those features represent a crucial part of the monitoring concept. Since most of these feature are configurable, that means a configuration error could lead to reduced monitoring capabilities thus leading to an unacceptable risk for the end user of the product. Therefore a continuous check of all relevant safety feature configurations is implemented in the module.

The configuration of safety feature module  are compared with  predefined configuration, if there is deviation then error reaction performed.

## Remarks: {#remarks .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- Refer [Safety function and safe state](safetyfunctionandsafestate.html){.topiclink} for details on the safety functions provided by the RCs and the related considerations to be observed.

- Refer [Failure detection possibilities](failuredetectionpossibilities.html){.topiclink} for a broader overview of the different failure reactions observed.

 

Error Reaction:.

  Error                          Reaction
  ------------------------------ -------------------------
  DFC                            No
  Error Code                     No
  High Power Outputs(\...,OFF)   Yes
  ECU Reset                      Yes
  Reaction time                  80 ms
  Reset Reason - Group ID        RBA_RESET_MOC
  Reset Reason  - Reset number   RBA_RESET_MOCSCC_FAILED
